name: claude-session-monitor
description: Context buildup, token costs, subagents, cache TTL and next-message cost for the current Claude Code session

commands.title: Session Monitor: Set session cost limit

sessionMonitor.claudeConfigDir.description: Claude Code config folder. Empty: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, else ~/.claude.

sessionMonitor.contextWindow.description: Context window in tokens. 0: from the session's model.

sessionMonitor.freshSessionTokens.description: Context size in tokens at which the advice becomes 'think about starting a new session'. 0 turns it off.

sessionMonitor.sessionCostLimit.description: Session cost in USD (API list prices) at which the panel and status bar turn red. 0 turns it off.

sessionMonitor.longSessionRereads.description: Re-read multiplier (cache reads ÷ current context) at which a session is flagged as long. 0 turns it off.

sessionMonitor.thresholds.description: Context % of the window at which the advice moves to 'think about starting a new session', 'wrap up', and 'don't send another message'.

scripts.package: npm run compile && vsce package --allow-missing-repository --skip-license -o session-monitor.vsix
